WITH film_copy_counts AS (
  SELECT f.film_id, f.rating, COUNT(i.inventory_id) AS copy_count
  FROM film AS f
  LEFT JOIN inventory AS i ON i.film_id = f.film_id
  GROUP BY f.film_id, f.rating
),
film_differences AS (
  SELECT film_id, rating, copy_count,
         copy_count - AVG(copy_count) OVER (PARTITION BY rating) AS difference_from_rating_avg,
         copy_count - AVG(copy_count) OVER () AS difference_from_overall_avg
  FROM film_copy_counts
)
SELECT film_id, rating, copy_count, difference_from_rating_avg, difference_from_overall_avg
FROM film_differences
ORDER BY difference_from_overall_avg DESC
LIMIT 10;
